title: Foundry collector registry
description: The inventory of deployed collectors. See contracts/collector-registry.yaml's header for why this is the inventory and not the plan.

name.description: Collector name; also the services/<name>/ directory.

path.description: Gateway prefix. Must equal helm/values/<name>/values.yaml's gateway.pathPrefix.

stage.description: The phase-8 sub-stage that shipped this collector. Documentary.

cadence_class.description: Must be one of collector_core.cadence.CadenceClass's values. tests/test_collector_registry.py asserts this enum still matches the code, so adding a cadence class in code fails until this schema is updated too.

envelope_version.description: String, matching collector_core.envelope.ENVELOPE_VERSION, contracts/signal-envelope/envelope.v1.schema.json's {"const": "1"}, every committed fixture, and what GET /catalog returns. It becomes the lake path segment `v1`. Typed as a string here so it cannot drift back to an integer; both gates now compare exactly rather than str()-ing both sides.

signal_types.description: Must match the service's CollectorDescriptor signal_types.

scope_aware.description: Whether the collector narrows to the roster scope. TYPE-CHECKED ONLY — no automated check confirms the value is correct.

depends_on.description: Names of other collectors in this registry. Self-dependency and cycles are rejected by the gate.
